# CG-REQ-033: Request oneOf variant added without discriminator

A oneOf branch was added to a request schema that has no discriminator.

**Why it matters:** oneOf requires exactly one matching branch.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.variantAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> A oneOf variant was added to {where} without a discriminator.
>
> Payloads that match both the new and an existing branch become invalid under oneOf exclusivity.
>
> **Fix:** Add a discriminator, or make sure the new branch cannot overlap existing ones.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: oneOf branch added without discriminator

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}, {type: boolean}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. A oneOf variant was added to POST /x: the request body (application/json) without a discriminator.

### Does not fire: with discriminator

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/A'}], discriminator: {propertyName: k}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/A'}, {$ref: '#/components/schemas/B'}], discriminator: {propertyName: k}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
  components:
    schemas:
      A: {type: object, properties: {k: {type: string}}}
      B: {type: object, properties: {k: {type: string}, b: {}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: anyOf

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {anyOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Branch overlap is not computed in v1.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-REQ-033
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-REQ-033: { severity: low }
```
